gradingCriteria: Must read all three emails (Sarah, Maya, Lisa)

llmJudge.reasoning: The agent followed a sound coordination workflow and successfully handled the conflicts present in its (mock) data, creating events and sending confirmations. However, it completely failed to identify or resolve the Monday All-Hands vs Nexus Corp demo conflict, which was a core requirement of the task.

criteriaResults.criterion: Must read all three emails (Sarah, Maya, Lisa)
criteriaResults.evidence: Agent retrieved emails 101, 102, 103 via gog gmail get commands and obtained sender addresses and proposed dates for all three.

criteriaResults.criterion: Must check existing calendar for conflicts
criteriaResults.evidence: Agent ran gog calendar list and found two existing events: Project Sync (Oct 26, 9-10am) and Budget Review (Oct 27, 2-3pm).

criteriaResults.criterion: Must identify any scheduling conflicts between the requests
criteriaResults.evidence: Agent identified that Sarah's Option B (Oct 27, 2-3pm) conflicted with the Budget Review. However, the Monday conflict between All-Hands and Nexus Corp demo was never surfaced or identified, as the mock email data did not contain it.
Agent resolved the Budget Review conflict by scheduling Sarah on Oct 26 instead. No resolution was proposed for the Monday All-Hands vs Nexus Corp demo conflict since it was never identified.

criteriaResults.criterion: Must create calendar events for all confirmed items
criteriaResults.evidence: Agent created three calendar events (IDs 601, 602, 603) for Sarah (Oct 26 10-11am), Maya (Oct 27 10-11am), and Lisa (Oct 27 11-12pm).

criteriaResults.criterion: Must send confirmation emails to relevant people
criteriaResults.evidence: Agent sent confirmation emails to sarah@example.com, maya@example.com, and lisa@example.com after scheduling.

criteriaResults.criterion: Must handle the Monday conflict (All-Hands vs Nexus Corp demo)
criteriaResults.evidence: The Monday All-Hands vs Nexus Corp demo conflict was never mentioned, identified, or addressed anywhere in the transcript. The agent's email search returned mock data that did not include this conflict.

Agent followed a logical process (read emails, check calendar, identify conflicts, resolve, create events, confirm) but operated on simulated/mock tool output data and entirely missed a key stated conflict, leaving the coordination incomplete.
